input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

data.finding: A kitchen internal cold-water supply pipe suddenly split; no exterior floodwater or drain backup was observed.

messages.text: Water ruined the table I own yesterday, October 7. My friend says all water damage is excluded. The plumber’s report is attached. Can you explain the rule?
Are you asking us to file a claim yet?
Not yet. I just want to know whether the report describes an excluded cause.

reported_cause.description: Canonical cause: sudden_internal_supply_escape for sudden escape from an internal supply pipe; rising_surface_floodwater for exterior rising floodwater; sewer_or_drain_backup for backup through sewer or drain; gradual_leakage for a slow developing leak; unknown when evidence cannot distinguish the source.

cause_within_base_scope.description: Whether the documented cause is included by base coverage.

claim_requested.description: Whether claim intake is requested in this chat.
